from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v != bg for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h))]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            vals = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                    grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]] 
            line.append(vals[0] if len(set(vals)) == 1 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
